answer: Require each identity to act as a vertex in a work graph that gains weight only through verified, useful service to others. A new vertex starts with zero trust and must complete small, checkable jobs whose outputs peers can replay and reject. Reputation is a harbor built slowly, not velvet handed out on request: it accumulates with completed work, decays when idle, and is lost when fraud is proven. An attacker creating thousands of vertices must pay the full cost of real work and a slashable stake for each one, so cloning identities costs more than cloning can ever earn.
